## Students

We supervise Masters and PhD students working on household finance in South
Africa. If you are a postgraduate student at Stellenbosch University with an
interest in the field, please [get in touch](/about/contact.html).

```{r}
#| output: asis
chf_people_grid(people$students, "student")
chf_stamp("_people.yml", "Team last updated")
```
